ilsp.reference: Given that the debate is public and being followed by a stunned European public, we are, in my opinion, all obliged to call on the High Representative of the Common Foreign and Security Policy of the European Union, who was recently the NATO Secretary-General and against whom an investigation by the International Court of Justice in The Hague is pending due to a complaint of crimes against humanity, as stated by the prosecutor in the newspaper "La Repubblica" and elsewhere, to explain to us - so that we cannot be accused of complicity - how he could agree to a "mini" nuclear war in the Balkans as NATO Secretary-General.

ilsp.query: Nicht nur auf dem Balkan, sondern auch im Golfkrieg waren zahlreiche britische Soldaten eingesetzt, und als Mitglied der britischen Konservativen möchte ich klar zum Ausdruck bringen, dass wir über die möglichen Gefahren durch die Verwendung von abgereichertem Uran natürlich besorgt sind, dass wir jedoch angesichts der Erklärung von Herrn Solana ein Moratorium der NATO für den Einsatz solcher Waffen nicht für sinnvoll halten.
ilsp.judge: Not only in the Balkans, but also in the Gulf War, numerous British soldiers were deployed, and as a member of the British Conservatives, I would like to clearly express that we are naturally concerned about the possible dangers of using depleted uranium, but in light of Mr. Solana's statement, we do not consider an NATO moratorium on the use of such weapons to be sensible.
ilsp.proxy: Not only in the Balkans, but also in the Gulf War, many British soldiers were deployed, and as a member of the British Conservatives, I would like to make it clear that we are of course concerned about the possible dangers of using enriched uranium, but we do not consider a NATO moratorium on the use of such weapons to be meaningful in light of Mr. Solana's statement.
ilsp.reference: Not only were numerous British soldiers deployed in the Balkans, but also in the Gulf War, and as a member of the British Conservatives, I wish to clearly express that we are naturally concerned about the possible dangers of using depleted uranium, but we do not consider a NATO moratorium on the use of such weapons to be sensible in light of Mr. Solana's statement.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte Ihnen danken und Ihnen sagen, dass ich am 31. zu einer Aussprache über den Nahen Osten wieder hier sein werde, dass ich Ihnen aber auch während der Plenarsitzung zur Verfügung stehe, um dieses Thema von so großem Interesse, bei dem viel für uns auf dem Spiel steht, weiter zu behandeln. Auf dem Spiel steht unsere Glaubwürdigkeit, und auf dem Spiel stehen auch unsere weiteren Schritte in Bezug auf das Krisenmanagement in der Europäischen Union.
ilsp.judge: I would like to thank you and tell you that I will be back here on the 31st for a discussion on the Middle East, that I will also be at your disposal during the plenary session to further address this topic of great interest, in which a lot is at stake for us. At stake is our credibility, and also at stake are our further steps regarding crisis management in the European Union.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to thank you and tell you that I will be here again on the 31st for a discussion on the Middle East, but I will also be available during the plenary session to continue this topic of great interest, in which a lot is at stake for us. Our credibility is at stake, and our further steps in terms of crisis management in the European Union are also at stake.
ilsp.reference: I would like to thank you and let you know that I will be here again for a discussion on the Middle East on the 31st, and I will also be available during the plenary session to continue dealing with this matter of great interest, in which a lot is at stake for us. Our credibility is at stake, and so are our further steps regarding crisis management in the European Union.

ilsp.query: Nichtsdestotrotz spüre ich eine gewisse Zuversicht und stelle fest, dass die EU-Staaten unkoordiniert angetreten sind - Herr Brok hat soeben davon gesprochen -, um die Anerkennung des stalinistischen Regimes von Pjöngjang zu wetteifern, wobei sie die Augen vor den Geschehnissen innerhalb des Landes, vor den dramatischen Menschenrechtsverletzungen, verschließen.
ilsp.judge: Despite this, I sense a certain degree of confidence and note that the EU states have approached uncoordinatedly - Mr Brok has just spoken about this - to compete for recognition of the Stalinist regime in Pyongyang, while closing their eyes to the events within the country, to the dramatic human rights violations.
ilsp.proxy: Nevertheless, I feel a certain optimism and find that the EU states have uncoordinated - Mr. Brok has just spoken about it - to compete for the recognition of the Stalinist regime of Pyongyang, while closing their eyes to the events within the country, to the dramatic human rights violations.
ilsp.reference: Despite this, I sense a certain optimism and I note that the EU member states have embarked on this uncoordinated - as Mr. Brok has just mentioned - competition to recognize the Stalinist regime in Pyongyang, while turning a blind eye to the events within the country, to the dramatic human rights abuses.

ilsp.query: Wenn es lediglich darum gegangen wäre, zu überwachen, dass die EU-Mittel nicht zur Finanzierung von Projekten verwendet werden, die zur Zerstörung dieser besonderen Ökosysteme beitragen, so hätte ich diesen Text akzeptiert und dafür gestimmt, aber es ist inakzeptabel und beispiellos, dass eine Unionspolitik von der Einhaltung einer anderen abhängig gemacht wird und dass ein Umweltkriterium beispielsweise gegenüber einem sozialen Kriterium Vorrang haben soll.
ilsp.judge: If it were merely a matter of monitoring that EU funds are not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these special ecosystems, I would have accepted and voted for this text, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that a Union policy is made dependent on compliance with another and that an environmental criterion, for example, is given priority over a social criterion.
ilsp.proxy: If it were merely about monitoring that EU funds are not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these special ecosystems, I would have accepted this text and voted for it, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that a Union policy is made dependent on compliance with another and that an environmental criterion should have priority over a social criterion, for example.
ilsp.reference: If it had merely been a matter of ensuring that EU funds are not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these unique ecosystems, I would have accepted this text and voted for it, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that a Union policy is made dependent on the observance of another and that an environmental criterion should take precedence over a social criterion, for example.

ilsp.query: Daraus geht eindeutig hervor, zu wessen Gunsten hier die "Engpässe in der Infrastruktur ", insbesondere in den "Verkehrs- und Energieinfrastrukturen " beseitigt, das "Finanzsystem effizient " gestaltet oder "transparente und demokratische institutionelle Rahmenbedingungen " geschaffen werden sollen, ein Euphemismus, mit dem man sich angesichts der allgegenwärtigen Korruption gegen sämtliche Beeinträchtigungen der westlichen Investoren wendet.
ilsp.judge: It clearly emerges in whose favour the "bottlenecks in infrastructure", particularly in "transport and energy infrastructure", are to be eliminated, the "financial system made efficient" or "transparent and democratic institutional framework conditions" created, an euphemism with which one addresses all the impairments to Western investors in view of the omnipresent corruption.
ilsp.proxy: It is clear from this that the "bottlenecks in the infrastructure", especially in the "transport and energy infrastructure", should be eliminated, the "financial system should be efficient" or "transparent and democratic institutional framework" should be created, a euphemism for which one turns to all the obstacles to Western investors in the face of widespread corruption.
ilsp.reference: It is clearly evident here whose interests are being served by eliminating the "bottlenecks in the infrastructure," particularly in the "traffic and energy infrastructures," by making the "financial system efficient" or by creating "transparent and democratic institutional frameworks," a euphemism used to address all the obstacles faced by Western investors in the face of ubiquitous corruption.

ilsp.query: Was den Wunsch nach Verzicht auf eine geographische Begrenzung für diese schnelle Eingreiftruppe anbelangt, so erinnert dies an die Raubzüge der früheren Kolonialmächte in Afrika und anderswo, wie sie etwa von Frankreich begangen wurden, um vom Volk abgelehnte Diktatoren zu schützen, oder wie sie derzeit von Großbritannien in Sierra Leone durchgeführt werden.
ilsp.judge: As for the desire to waive geographical restrictions for this rapid intervention force, this is reminiscent of the raids of former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those committed by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or as currently being carried out by Great Britain in Sierra Leone.
ilsp.proxy: As for the desire to waive the geographical limitation for this rapid response force, this reminds us of the raids of the former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those committed by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or as they are currently being carried out by Britain in Sierra Leone.
ilsp.reference: As for the desire to forgo geographical limitations for this rapid intervention force, this recalls the raids of the former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those committed by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or those currently being carried out by the United Kingdom in Sierra Leone.

ilsp.query: Der Vorschlag für eine Verordnung zur Schaffung der Sonderfazilität für Kriseneinsätze ist nichts anderes als der Rahmen für zwar nichtmilitärische, aber nichtsdestoweniger imperialistische politische und wirtschaftliche Interventionen in jedem beliebigen Teil der Welt. Was die führenden Kreise der EU anstreben, ist ein Mechanismus zur sofortigen Mobilisierung von Human- und Finanzressourcen, der rasch eingesetzt werden kann, und zwar nicht nur in "Krisensituationen " (vielleicht könnten uns die Verfasser des Textes einmal sagen, welche Merkmale eine "Krisensituation " kennzeichnen), sondern auch dann, wenn lediglich eine Bedrohung oder selbst nur eine Beeinträchtigung der so genannten Unterstützungs- und Kooperationsprogramme mit diesen Ländern zu befürchten ist.
ilsp.judge: The proposal for a regulation to create the special facility for crisis management is nothing other than the framework for non-military, yet nonetheless imperialist, political and economic interventions in any part of the world. What the leading EU circles are striving for is a mechanism for the immediate mobilization of human and financial resources that can be rapidly deployed, not only in "crisis situations" (perhaps the authors of the text could tell us once what characteristics define a "crisis situation"), but also when merely a threat or even just an impairment of the so-called support and cooperation programs with these countries is to be feared.
ilsp.proxy: The proposal for a regulation to create the special facility for crisis operations is nothing more than the framework for non-military, but nonetheless imperialist political and economic interventions in any part of the world. What the leading circles of the EU are seeking is a mechanism for the immediate mobilization of human and financial resources that can be quickly deployed, not only in "crisis situations" (perhaps the authors of the text could tell us once what characteristics a "crisis situation" has), but also when only a threat or even a disruption of the so-called support and cooperation programs with these countries is to be feared.
ilsp.reference: The proposal for a regulation to establish a special facility for crisis interventions is nothing other than the framework for non-military, yet nonetheless imperialist, political and economic interventions in any part of the world. ilsp.query: Abgesehen davon spricht der Entschließungsantrag kurz überaus ernste Fragen im Zusammenhang mit der Analyse und der notwendigen Erforschung von abgereichertem Uran an, geht aber an keiner Stelle auf die fortgesetzten Bemühungen ein, Tatsachen, unabhängige, uns allen bekannte Forschungsarbeiten, ja sogar wissenschaftliche Abhandlungen aus NATO-Ländern zu verschleiern und zu verheimlichen, die die Gefährlichkeit von abgereichertem Uran nachweisen und Vorsorgemaßnahmen nennen, die diese Länder ihren Streitkräften auferlegen.
ilsp.judge: Apart from that, the resolution proposal briefly addresses extremely serious questions related to the analysis and necessary research of depleted uranium, but does not address anywhere the continued efforts to conceal and hide facts, independent, well-known research works, even scientific papers from NATO countries that prove the dangers of depleted uranium and name precautionary measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.
ilsp.proxy: Apart from that, the resolution briefly addresses extremely serious questions in connection with the analysis and the necessary research of enriched uranium, but does not go into the continued efforts to conceal facts, independent, well-known research, even scientific papers from NATO countries, which prove the danger of enriched uranium and recommend preventive measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.
ilsp.reference: Apart from that, the resolution proposal briefly addresses extremely serious questions related to the analysis and necessary research of depleted uranium, but it does not address the continued efforts to conceal and cover up facts, independent and well-known research works, yes, even scientific papers from NATO countries, which demonstrate the danger of depleted uranium and recommend preventive measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.

ilsp.query: Wir fordern die EU außerdem auf, die UN-Hochkommissarin für Menschenrechte sowie die anderen internationalen Organisationen und die NRO im Kampf gegen die Unterdrückung unabhängiger Medien - ein Punkt, den Lord Bethell bereits angesprochen hat - sowie von Journalisten und Schriftstellern zu unterstützen und alle Staaten dazu anzuhalten, die Zensur abzuschaffen, das Recht auf Zugang zu offiziellen Informationen zu schützen und die Einschränkungen beim Zugang zur modernen Informationstechnologie aufzuheben, die oft die Rettung für unterdrückte Menschen ist.
ilsp.judge: We also call on the EU to support the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights and other international organisations and NGOs in the fight against the suppression of independent media - a point Lord Bethell has already raised - and journalists and writers, and to urge all states to abolish censorship, protect the right of access to official information, and lift restrictions on access to modern information technology, which is often the salvation for oppressed people.
ilsp.proxy: We also call on the EU to support the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights and other international organizations and NGOs in the fight against the suppression of independent media - a point raised by Lord Bethell - and to encourage all states to abolish censorship, protect the right of access to official information and lift restrictions on access to modern information technology, which is often the salvation for oppressed people.
ilsp.reference: We also call on the EU to support the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights and other international organizations and NGOs in the fight against the suppression of independent media - a point that Lord Bethell has already mentioned - as well as journalists and writers, and to urge all states to abolish censorship, protect the right to access official information, and lift restrictions on access to modern information technology, which is often the lifeline for oppressed people.

ilsp.query: Der von mir bereits erwähnte Beschluss besagt, dass ein Bürger eines EU-Mitgliedstaates, der sich um konsularische Hilfe an eine diplomatische oder konsularische Vertretung eines anderen Mitgliedstaates wendet, so zu behandeln ist, als wäre er Bürger des Landes, das durch die betreffende Botschaft oder das Konsulat vertreten wird.
ilsp.judge: The decision I have already mentioned states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular mission of another member state is to be treated as if he were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate in question.
ilsp.proxy: The decision mentioned above states that a citizen of an EU Member State who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular mission of another Member State is to be treated as if he were a citizen of the country represented by the relevant embassy or consulate.
ilsp.reference: The decision I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state is to be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the relevant embassy or consulate.

ilsp.query: Der Rat begrüßt außerdem die Tatsache, dass sich die EU und die ASEAN in ihrer in Vientiane beschlossenen gemeinsamen Erklärung verpflichten, die Bemühungen des Sonderbeauftragten des UNO-Generalsekretärs für Birma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, um eine positive Entwicklung in Burma zu unterstützen.
ilsp.judge: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN, in their joint declaration adopted in Vientiane, undertook to support the efforts of the UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy for Burma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, towards a positive development in Burma.
ilsp.proxy: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint statement adopted in Vientiane to support the efforts of the Special Envoy of the UN Secretary-General for Burma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Burma.
ilsp.reference: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint statement adopted in Vientiane to supporting the efforts of the UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy for Myanmar, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Myanmar.

ilsp.query: Nach der Tagesordnung folgt der Bericht (A5-0381/2000) von Frau Hedkvist Petersen im Namen des Ausschusses für Regionalpolitik, Verkehr und Fremdenverkehr über die Mitteilung der Kommission an den Rat, das Europäische Parlament, den Wirtschafts- und Sozialausschuss und den Ausschuss der Regionen: Prioritäten für die Sicherheit des Straßenverkehrs in der EU - Fortschrittsbericht und Einstufung der Maßnahmen.
ilsp.judge: Following the agenda is the report (A5-0381/2000) by Mrs Hedkvist Petersen on behalf of the Committee on Regional Policy, Transport and Tourism on the Commission's communication to the Council, the European Parliament, the Economic and Social Committee and the Committee of the Regions: Priorities for road safety in the EU - progress report and classification of measures.
ilsp.proxy: After the agenda, the report (A5-0381/2000) by Mrs Hedkvist Petersen on behalf of the Committee on Regional Policy, Transport and Tourism on the Commission's communication to the Council, the European Parliament, the Economic and Social Committee and the Committee of the Regions: Priorities for road safety in the EU - Progress report and assessment of measures follows.
ilsp.reference: Following the agenda, the report (A5-0381/2000) by Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen on behalf of the Committee on Regional Policy, Transport and Tourism on the Commission's communication to the Council, the European Parliament, the Economic and Social Committee and the Committee of the Regions: Priorities for road safety in the EU - Progress report and assessment of measures.

ilsp.query: Meines Erachtens wird hierdurch deutlich, dass die Verkehrssicherheit nicht mit herausgegriffenen Einzelmaßnahmen im erforderlichen Maße erhöht werden kann, sondern dass dies nur durch einen ganzen Komplex von Maßnahmen machbar ist, und dazu gehören Verkehrserziehung, Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung, Alkoholbegrenzung, besserer Straßenausbau, Verkehrsleitsysteme, erhöhter Sicherheitsstandard der Fahrzeuge, stärkere Kontrollen der Einhaltung der Straßenverkehrsordnung und auch eine permanente Begutachtung der Fahrzeuge, die sich im Straßenverkehr befinden.
ilsp.judge: In my opinion, this makes it clear that road safety cannot be sufficiently increased by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive package of measures, which includes traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, improved road construction, traffic guidance systems, a higher safety standard for vehicles, stricter controls on compliance with the road traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles in road traffic.
ilsp.proxy: In my opinion, it is clear that traffic safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but only by a whole complex of measures, and these include traffic education, speed limit, alcohol limit, better road construction, traffic control systems, increased safety standards of vehicles, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations and also a permanent assessment of the vehicles that are in traffic.
ilsp.reference: In my opinion, it becomes clear that road safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive set of measures, including traffic education, speed limits, alcohol restrictions, improved road infrastructure, traffic management systems, enhanced vehicle safety standards, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles that are in operation on the roads.

ilsp.query: Informationskampagnen zu besten Praktiken in den Staaten der EU und verpflichtende Maßnahmen zur Reduzierung der Unfallursachen wie Alkohol, Drogengenuss und Medikamenteneinnahme, aber auch eine die Kreativität der Automobilindustrie fördernde Richtlinie zur Ausweitung von Sicherheitstests bzw. zur Förderung des Programms zur Bewertung von Neufahrzeugen, Euro-NCAP, können dies beweisen.
ilsp.judge: Information campaigns on best practices in EU states and mandatory measures to reduce accident causes such as alcohol, drug use, and medication intake, but also a guideline promoting the creativity of the automotive industry to expand safety tests or to promote the Euro-NCAP program for assessing new vehicles, can prove this.
ilsp.proxy: Information campaigns on best practices in the EU states and mandatory measures to reduce the causes of accidents such as alcohol, drug use and medication intake, but also a directive that encourages the creativity of the automotive industry to expand safety tests or to promote the New Car Assessment Program, Euro-NCAP, can prove this.
ilsp.reference: Information campaigns on best practices in EU member states and binding measures to reduce accident causes such as alcohol, drug use, and medication intake, as well as a directive that promotes the creativity of the automotive industry by expanding safety tests or promoting the Euro-NCAP new vehicle assessment program, can prove this.

ilsp.query: Jene, die darauf setzen, dass die formelle Gleichstellung, der Faktor Zeit und die selbstregulierenden Mechanismen quasi von selbst ein soziales Gleichgewicht herstellen, irren. Sicher sind die Gleichstellung vor dem Gesetz und die Chancengleichheit unerlässliche Voraussetzungen, doch dabei dürfen wir es nicht belassen.
ilsp.judge: Those who rely on formal equality, the factor of time, and self-regulating mechanisms to more or less automatically establish social equilibrium are mistaken. Certainly, equality before the law and equal opportunities are essential prerequisites, but we must not stop there.
ilsp.proxy: Those who bet that formal equality, the factor of time, and the self-regulating mechanisms will almost automatically establish a social equilibrium are mistaken. Of course, equality before the law and equal opportunities are indispensable prerequisites, but we must not stop there.
ilsp.reference: Those who believe that formal equality, the factor of time, and self-regulating mechanisms will automatically establish a social equilibrium are mistaken. While legal equality and equal opportunities are essential prerequisites, we must not stop there.

ilsp.query: In unserer Stellungnahme wollten wir die gesamte Herstellungskette der Forstwirtschaft einschließlich der Waldpflege und Holzgewinnung sowie der Bedeutung von Rentabilität der Forstwirtschaft als Rohstoffgrundlage herausstellen, gründet sich doch eine nachhaltige europäische Forstwirtschaft nach wie vor auf die sogenannte "Familienwirtschaft " von zwölf Millionen privaten Waldbesitzern und ihrer Tätigkeit.
ilsp.judge: In our statement, we wanted to highlight the entire production chain of forestry, including forest care and wood harvesting, as well as the importance of the profitability of forestry as a raw material base, as sustainable European forestry is still based on the so-called "family economy" of twelve million private forest owners and their activities.
ilsp.proxy: In our statement, we wanted to highlight the entire production chain of the forestry industry, including forest management and timber harvesting, as well as the importance of the profitability of the forestry industry as a raw material basis, as a sustainable European forestry is still based on the so-called "family farming" of twelve million private forest owners and their activities.
ilsp.reference: In our statement, we wanted to highlight the entire production chain of forestry, including forest management and wood harvesting, as well as the importance of forestry profitability as a raw material basis, since a sustainable European forestry system still relies on the so-called "family forestry" of twelve million private forest owners and their activities.

ilsp.query: Herr Kollege Posselt, selbst wenn es wirklich eine Bereicherung wäre, wenn Sie 20 Minuten redeten - ich könnte ja dann auch 20 Minuten reden, weil auch von unserer Fraktion keiner mehr da ist -, wäre es in der Tat so, dass die Arbeit, die der Kollege Deprez sehr sorgfältig durchgeführt hat, hier nicht in dem Maße diskutiert werden könnte, wie es angemessen wäre.
ilsp.judge: Mr. Colleague Posselt, even if it were truly an enrichment if you spoke for 20 minutes - I could also speak for 20 minutes, because no one from our faction is here anymore -, it would indeed be the case that the work, which colleague Deprez has carried out very carefully, could not be discussed here to the extent that would be appropriate.

ilsp.query: Vor allem für die Angehörigen der Opfer ist es nämlich unerträglich, dass noch keiner der Kommandeure der Roten Khmer für die von ihnen verübten Verbrechen bestraft worden ist und die Hauptschuldigen am Genozid völlig unbehelligt in Kambodscha leben, ganz zu schweigen von der Beteiligung ehemaliger Roter Khmer an der Regierung.
ilsp.judge: Above all, it is unbearable for the relatives of the victims that none of the commanders of the Red Khmer have been punished for the crimes they committed and that those mainly responsible for the genocide live completely untroubled in Cambodia, not to mention the participation of former Red Khmer in the government.
ilsp.proxy: Especially for the relatives of the victims, it is unbearable that none of the commanders of the Khmer Rouge has been punished for the crimes they committed and that the main culprits of the genocide are living completely unharmed in Cambodia, not to mention the involvement of former Khmer Rouge in the government.
ilsp.reference: Above all, it is unbearable for the relatives of the victims that none of the commanders of the Khmer Rouge have been punished for the crimes they committed, and that the main perpetrators of the genocide are completely unharmed and living in Cambodia, not to mention the involvement of former Khmer Rouge members in the government.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Älteren unter uns haben die außergewöhnlichen, grauenhaften Berichte, die 1975 aus Kambodscha kamen, noch nicht vergessen. Es gab Luftaufnahmen von einer verlassenen Hauptstadt, weil die Roten Khmer, deren Anführer nach den Lehrsätzen der Gewalt in der Tradition der französischen Revolution geschult wurden und von einer Mischung aus politischem Idealismus und Massenpsychopathologie erfüllt waren, zwei Millionen Menschen von der Stadt auf das Land umsiedelten, um unter der Führung des "großen " Pol Pot im Jahre Null mit einer neuen Gesellschaft zu beginnen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, the older among us have not yet forgotten the extraordinary, horrific reports that came from Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city, because the Red Khmer, whose leaders were trained in the teachings of violence in the tradition of the French Revolution and were filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathology, relocated two million people from the city to the countryside, to begin a new society under the leadership of the "great" Pol Pot in Year Zero.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, the elders among us have not forgotten the extraordinary, horrifying reports that came out of Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city because the Red Khmer, whose leader was trained in the teachings of violence in the tradition of the French Revolution and was filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathology, relocated two million people from the city to the countryside to begin a new society under the leadership of "great" Pol Pot in the year zero.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, those of us who are older have not forgotten the extraordinary, horrific reports that came from Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city, because the Red Khmer, whose leaders were trained in the teachings of violence in the tradition of the French Revolution and were filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathology, forcibly relocated two million people from the city to the countryside to begin a new society under the leadership of the "great" Pol Pot in Year Zero.

ilsp.query: Ein Politiker, der vor kurzem gestorben ist, Son San, ein Demokrat, der den schweren Weg zwischen den Roten Khmer auf der einen Seite und dem pro-vietnamesischen Marionettenregime auf der anderen Seite gegangen ist, hat vor allem mit Hilfe der EU und des Europäischen Parlaments Schritt für Schritt die Wiederherstellung eines demokratischen Kambodscha vorangetrieben.
ilsp.judge: A politician who recently passed away, Son San, a democrat who took the difficult path between the Red Khmer on the one hand and the pro-Vietnamese puppet regime on the other, has above all, with the help of the EU and the European Parliament, step by step promoted the restoration of a democratic Cambodia.
ilsp.proxy: A politician who recently died, Son San, a democrat who walked the difficult path between the Red Khmer on one side and the pro-Vietnamese puppet regime on the other, has mainly advanced the restoration of a democratic Cambodia step by step with the help of the EU and the European Parliament.
ilsp.reference: A politician who recently passed away, Son San, a democrat who walked the difficult path between the Khmer Rouge on one side and the pro-Vietnamese puppet regime on the other, has above all, with the help of the EU and the European Parliament, step by step, driven forward the restoration of a democratic Cambodia.

ilsp.query: Wir warten vergebens auf den einzigen geeigneten Vorschlag, um die gesamte Region zu stabilisieren, um vor die Tore Tschetscheniens zu gelangen, um der russischen Umklammerung dieser Region ein Ende zu setzen, den einzigen seriösen Vorschlag, der darin bestünde, dass Georgien offiziell vorgeschlagen wird, der Europäischen Union beizutreten.
ilsp.judge: We are in vain waiting for the only suitable proposal to stabilize the entire region, to reach the gates of Chechnya, to put an end to the Russian stranglehold on this region, the only serious proposal that would consist of Georgia being officially proposed to join the European Union.
ilsp.proxy: We are waiting in vain for the only appropriate proposal to stabilize the entire region in order to reach the gates of Chechnya in order to put an end to the Russian encirclement of this region, the only serious proposal that would consist of Georgia officially being proposed to join the European Union.

ilsp.query: Ich freue mich, dass derzeit eine Delegation unserer Nachbarn, der Parlamentarischen Versammlung des Europarates, in Tschetschenien ist, und ich möchte an den Kommissar appellieren, bald nach Georgien und nach Tschetschenien zu fahren und sich die Menschenrechtssituation an Ort und Stelle genau anzuschauen, so wie dies der Europarat intensiv tut.
ilsp.judge: I am pleased that a delegation of our neighbours, the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe, is currently in Chechnya, and I would like to appeal to the Commissioner to travel to Georgia and to Chechnya soon and to take a close look at the human rights situation on the spot, as the Council of Europe is doing intensively.
ilsp.proxy: I am pleased that a delegation of our neighbors, the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe, is currently in Chechnya, and I would like to appeal to the Commissioner to travel to Georgia and Chechnya soon and see the human rights situation on the spot, as the Council of Europe does intensively.
ilsp.reference: I am pleased that a delegation from our neighbors, the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe, is currently in Chechnya, and I would like to appeal to the Commissioner to travel to Georgia and Chechnya soon and to take a close look at the human rights situation on the ground, just as the Council of Europe does intensively.

lsp.query: Meiner Ansicht nach können wir nicht auf der einen Seite die Vollbeschäftigung zu einer Aktionspriorität der Europäischen Union erheben und uns mit der Ausarbeitung eines Statuts der Europäischen Aktiengesellschaft beschäftigen, das neue Rechte für Arbeitnehmer vorsieht, und auf der anderen Seite passiv eine derartige Strategie hinnehmen, die den Gesetzen der Aktienmärkte Vorrang vor allen anderen Erwägungen einräumt.
lsp.judge: In my view, we cannot on the one hand make full employment a priority action of the European Union and work on a statute for the European company which provides new rights for employees, and on the other hand passively accept a strategy which gives precedence to the laws of the stock market over all other considerations.
lsp.proxy: In my opinion, we cannot make full employment a top priority of the European Union on one hand and simultaneously engage in drafting a statute for the European Stock Corporation that grants new rights to employees, while on the other hand passively accepting a strategy that gives precedence to the laws of stock markets over all other considerations.
lsp.reference: In my opinion, we cannot elevate full employment to a priority of the European Union on one side and engage in drafting a statute for the European Company that provides new rights for employees, while passively accepting a strategy on the other side that gives precedence to the laws of the stock markets over all other considerations.

lsp.query: Ich möchte die Präsidentin bitten, der Regierung in Ankara gegenüber unsere Sorge über diesen Vorfall sowie unsere Hoffnung, dass dieser bedauerliche Vorfall die Lösung des Zypernproblems und die wieder aufgenommenen Friedensverhandlungen nicht beeinträchtigen möge, wie wir auch hoffen, dass Herr Tsiakourmas so schnell wie möglich wieder auf freien Fuß gesetzt wird.
lsp.judge: I would like to ask the President to express to the government in Ankara our concern about this incident, as well as our hope that this unfortunate incident will not affect the solution to the Cyprus problem and the resumed peace talks, just as we also hope that Mr. Tsiakourmas will be released as soon as possible.
lsp.proxy: I would like to ask the President to convey our concern about this incident to the government in Ankara, and to express our hope that this regrettable incident does not impair the solution of the Cyprus problem and the resumed peace negotiations, as we also hope for Mr. Tsiakourmas to be set free as soon as possible.

lsp.query: Zudem lehnt es Herr Denktasch, der Führer "Nord-Zyperns ", das - nur zur Erinnerung - unter türkischer Besatzung steht, ab, an weiteren Gesprächen zur Lösung des Zypernproblems teilzunehmen. lsp.query: Um eine qualitativ hochstehende Schulbildung zu sichern, sind genügend Schulen, Klassen mit einer begrenzten Schülerzahl, eine ausreichende Zahl von Lehrkräften, Lehrer und technisches sowie Verwaltungspersonal auf allen Unterrichtsstufen, angefangen von der Grundschule, erforderlich, denn in allen Ländern Europas beginnt gerade in den Grundschulklassen ein Differenzierungsprozess, der sich für die Kinder der weniger begüterten Schichten in einem vielfach nicht wieder auszugleichenden Bildungsrückstand äußert.
lsp.judge: To ensure a high-quality school education, sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teachers, instructors, and technical as well as administrative staff at all levels of instruction, starting from elementary school, are required, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins precisely in the elementary school classes, which for children from less affluent backgrounds often results in an educational disadvantage that cannot be compensated for in many cases.
lsp.proxy: To ensure high-quality school education, there must be sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teachers, educators, and technical as well as administrative personnel at all levels of instruction, starting from primary school, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins in primary school classes that results in an educational disadvantage for children from less affluent backgrounds, which is often not fully reversible.
lsp.reference: To ensure a high-quality education, sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teaching staff, teachers, and technical as well as administrative personnel are required at all levels of instruction, starting from elementary school, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins in elementary school classes, which manifests itself in a frequently irreparable educational backlog for the children of less affluent strata.

lsp.query: Daher müssen wir in diesem Rahmen der Verteidigung, der Wahrung und Förderung unseres Erbes unsere Architektur erhalten, unser Handwerk unterstützen, unsere Landschaften pflegen und erschließen, doch - und das möchte ich hervorheben - ohne sie vom Leben abzuschneiden und ohne die darin lebendigen Traditionen und kulturellen Gebräuche auszuschließen.
lsp.judge: Therefore, within this framework of defending, preserving, and promoting our heritage, we must preserve our architecture, support our craftsmanship, cultivate and develop our landscapes, but - and I would like to emphasize this - without isolating them from life and without excluding the living traditions and cultural customs that thrive within them.
lsp.proxy: Therefore, within this framework of defense, preservation, and promotion of our heritage, we must retain our architecture, support our craftsmanship, and conserve and develop our landscapes; yet - and this is what I want to emphasize - we must not cut them off from life and exclude the living traditions and cultural customs that exist within them.

lsp.query: Wir werden nicht für den Bericht Staes stimmen, obgleich er nicht wenige zutreffende Feststellungen und Vorschläge enthält, denn generell kommt darin eine Auffassung zum Ausdruck, die der imperialistischen Präsenz nicht im Entferntesten etwas entgegensetzt und deren einziges Anliegen darin besteht, diese zu verklären, um sie den Völkern schmackhaft zu machen.
lsp.judge: We will not vote for the Staes report, although it contains not a few accurate findings and proposals, because in general it expresses a view that does not oppose imperialist presence in the slightest and whose sole concern is to embellish it in order to make it palatable to the peoples.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich habe zwar für den Bericht Dell'Alba gestimmt, doch möchte ich betonen, dass sich hinter dieser Zustimmung mein Standpunkt als Vertreter der italienischen Rentnerpartei verbirgt, den ich hiermit darlegen möchte: Ich bin unter allen Umständen gegen die inzwischen übliche und zur Gewohnheit gewordene Forderung, die Strukturfonds und die Gemeinschaftshilfen zu den einzelstaatlichen Hilfen hinzuzurechnen.
lsp.judge: Mr President, although I voted in favour of the Dell'Alba report, I would like to stress that behind this approval lies my position as a representative of the Italian pensioners' party, which I would like to outline as follows: I am, under all circumstances, opposed to the now common and habitual demand to add the Structural Funds and Community assistance to national assistance.

lsp.query: Vergegenwärtigen wir uns doch bloß einmal - und dabei beziehe ich mich auf mein Land -, wie in der Milchwirtschaft nun wirklich alles, vom Grashalm bis zur Milchablieferung im Supermarkt, kontrolliert wird, wie ferner Landwirte und Gärtner schon seit langem eine lückenlose Umwelt- und Kundenbuchhaltung führen müssen - was sie ja auch überaus engagiert tun -, und wie gleichzeitig die Tierschutzbestimmungen in den Ländern der Europäischen Union zu den weltweit strengsten gehören.
lsp.judge: Let's just take a moment to consider - and I'm referring to my country here - how everything in the dairy industry, from the blade of grass to the milk delivery in the supermarket, is actually controlled, how farmers and gardeners have been required to maintain comprehensive environmental and customer accounting for a long time - which they also do with great dedication -, and how at the same time, the animal welfare regulations in the countries of the European Union are among the strictest in the world.

lsp.query: Einrichtungen, die mit Grenzarbeitnehmern zu tun haben, sind für den Grundsatz des Wohnlandes, die Gewerkschaften plädieren für den Grundsatz des Beschäftigungslandes, die Regierung selbst wiederum spricht sich für das Wohnlandprinzip aus usw. usw. Da der Knoten jedoch endlich einmal durchgeschlagen werden muss, werden wir einige der von Frau Oomen-Ruijten eingereichten Änderungsanträge, denen zufolge beide Grundsätze gemischt angewendet werden sollten, nicht unterstützen und schlagen vor, den Grundsatz des Beschäftigungslandes als Ausgangspunkt zu nehmen und auf das so genannte europäische Sozialmodell hinzuarbeiten.
lsp.judge: Institutions dealing with cross-border workers are in favour of the principle of the country of residence, the trade unions are in favour of the principle of the country of employment, the government itself is in favour of the principle of the country of residence, and so on. However, since the knot must finally be cut, we will not support some of the amendments submitted by Mrs Oomen-Ruijten, which suggest that both principles should be applied in a mixed manner, and propose to take the principle of the country of employment as a starting point and work towards the so-called European social model.

lsp.query: Dazu zählen die Umwelthaftung, durch die die Mitgliedstaaten stärker in die Pflicht genommen werden, die bestehenden Vorschriften und Regelungen einzuhalten. lsp.query: Es hat wenig genutzt, dass wir die Habitat-Richtlinie und die Errichtung des Netzes "Natura 2000 " zum Schutz von für die Gemeinschaft wichtigen Gebieten beschlossen haben, wenn die Kommission seit 1995 darauf wartet, dass alle Mitgliedstaaten die endgültige Liste dieser Gebiete sowie die entsprechenden Programme, Regelungen und Mechanismen zu deren Bewirtschaftung vorlegen.
lsp.judge: It has been of little use that we have adopted the Habitat Directive and the establishment of the "Natura 2000" network to protect areas important to the Community, if the Commission has been waiting since 1995 for all Member States to submit the final list of these areas as well as the corresponding programmes, arrangements and mechanisms for their management.

lsp.query: Ich möchte zwei Aspekte dieser Entwicklung hervorheben: Zum einen wird in unseren Ländern der Umweltschutz nur zögerlich in die Konzepte der verschiedenen sektoralen Politiken aufgenommen und stattdessen nach wie vor als eine Reihe von im Nachhinein durchzuführenden Maßnahmen betrachtet, mit denen eventuelle Schäden behoben werden können; zum anderen werden gerade aufgrund dieses nachträglichen Handelns die Kosten der Umsetzung der Richtlinien häufig als zu belastend und nicht wirklich sinnvoll empfunden, was auch auf die knappen von den Mitgliedstaaten bereitgestellten Mittel zurückzuführen ist.
lsp.judge: I would like to highlight two aspects of this development: Firstly, environmental protection is only being gradually incorporated into the concepts of various sectoral policies in our countries, and is instead still viewed as a series of measures to be implemented retrospectively to rectify any potential damage; secondly, precisely due to this retrospective approach, the costs of implementing the directives are often perceived as too burdensome and not really meaningful, which can also be attributed to the limited funds provided by the Member States.
lsp.proxy: I would like to highlight two aspects of this development: On one hand, environmental protection is only slowly being integrated into the concepts of various sectoral policies and is still primarily viewed as a series of measures to be implemented after the fact, aimed at remedying any potential damage; on the other hand, precisely because of this reactive approach, the costs of implementing the directives are often perceived as overly burdensome and not really worthwhile, which also reflects the scarce resources provided by the member states.

lsp.query: Auch ich schließe mich der Auffassung an, dass das Fünfte Umweltaktionsprogramm hauptsächlich auf einen sektoralen Ansatz der Umweltpolitik abzielte, und vielleicht sollten wir, wenn wir uns Gedanken über das Sechste Programm machen, mehr Nachdruck auf die Einbeziehung der sozioökonomischen Akteure sowie der lokalen Behörden bei der Erreichung der jeweils festgelegten Ziele legen, damit der Schutz unserer Umwelt immer mehr in die Gesamtplanung integriert wird.
lsp.judge: I also share the view that the Fifth Environmental Action Programme mainly focused on a sectoral approach to environmental policy, and perhaps when we think about the Sixth Programme, we should place more emphasis on involving socio-economic actors and local authorities in achieving the set objectives, so that the protection of our environment is increasingly integrated into overall planning.

lsp.query: In diesem Kontext wird es wichtig sein, wie es in unserem Entschließungsantrag heißt, beispielsweise auch über das Internet eine weite Verbreitung der besten und der schlechtesten Ergebnisse der Mitgliedstaaten bei der Umsetzung der Umweltrichtlinien zu gewährleisten, um ihr unterschiedliches Engagement in diesem Bereich deutlich zu machen und die Öffentlichkeit über das Verhalten der Mitgliedstaaten urteilen zu lassen, was fast immer auch wirksamer ist als ein Urteil des Gerichtshofs.
lsp.judge: In this context, it will be important, as stated in our resolution, for example, to also ensure via the internet a wide dissemination of the best and worst results of the Member States in implementing environmental directives, in order to clearly demonstrate their differing levels of commitment in this area and to allow the public to judge the behaviour of the Member States, which is almost always more effective than a ruling by the Court of Justice.

lsp.query: Ich freue mich, dass ich den Großteil dessen, was die Vorsitzende des Ausschusses für Umweltfragen, Volksgesundheit und Verbraucherpolitik gesagt hat, unterstützen kann, wenngleich mir dabei nicht ganz wohl ist, denn die nächste Strafe, die der Europäische Gerichtshof verhängt, trifft möglicherweise das Vereinigte Königreich, weil es die Vorgaben der Badegewässer-Richtlinie trotz hoher Ausgaben und großer Anstrengungen immer noch nicht erfüllt.
lsp.judge: I am pleased to be able to support most of what the Chair of the Committee on the Environment, Public Health and Consumer Policy has said, although I do not feel entirely comfortable doing so, because the next penalty imposed by the European Court of Justice may well be on the United Kingdom, because despite high expenditure and great efforts, it still fails to meet the requirements of the Bathing Water Directive.

lsp.query: Selbstverständlich liegt die finanzielle und rechtliche Hauptverantwortung dafür bei den Mitgliedstaaten, aber die EU darf sich nicht darauf beschränken, Rechtsvorschriften zu erlassen und Fondsmittel bereitzustellen - was natürlich positiv ist - sondern muss auch die vielen vorhandenen guten Beispiele bekannt machen und eigene finanzielle Mittel dafür einsetzen, um eine positive Entwicklung zu fördern.
lsp.judge: Of course, the financial and legal main responsibility for this lies with the Member States, but the EU must not limit itself to enacting legislation and providing funds - which is positive, of course - but must also publicize the many good examples that already exist and use its own financial resources to promote positive development.

lsp.query: Einmal im Hinblick auf den Umweltschutz, den Hauptzweck der Richtlinien. lsp.judge: On the one hand, with regard to environmental protection, the main purpose of the guidelines. But it is also very important that trust in EU legislation is not shaken by Member States failing to implement the laws for a long time, on whose adoption in the Council of Ministers they themselves were involved.

lsp.query: Abschließend möchte ich Neil Parish und der Kommission empfehlen, diesen Bericht nicht als einen Schlusspunkt, sondern als Ausgangspunkt für ein gründliches Nachdenken über die Erneuerung der Landwirtschaft und die Reform der Gemeinsamen Agrarpolitik unter Einbeziehung vor allem der Vereinigungen der Junglandwirte zu sehen.
lsp.judge: In conclusion, I would like to recommend to Neil Parish and the Commission that they view this report not as a full stop, but as a starting point for thorough reflection on the renewal of agriculture and the reform of the Common Agricultural Policy, particularly involving the associations of young farmers.

lsp.query: Diese zukünftige soziale Gemeinschaft bildet die Grundlage der Gemeinsamen Agrarpolitik, für die wir die Niederlassungsbeihilfe und die zusätzlichen Investitionshilfen verstärken müssen, hauptsächlich in jenen strukturschwachen Regionen mit zahlreichen stillgelegten Betrieben und verlassenen Dörfern, wo die jungen Leute die ländliche Wirtschaft wieder ankurbeln können, und zwar durch die Entwicklung von neuartigen Produkten wie dem Agrotourismus, dem ländlichen Tourismus von regionaler Bedeutung oder durch die Wiederansiedlung von Tier- und Pflanzenarten in diesen Naturräumen, womit ein Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen und dauerhaften Entwicklung der Region geleistet wird.
lsp.judge: This future social community forms the basis of the Common Agricultural Policy, for which we must strengthen the settlement aid and additional investment aid, mainly in those structurally weak regions with numerous abandoned businesses and deserted villages, where young people can revive the rural economy, and this through the development of innovative products such as agrotourism, rural tourism of regional importance, or through the reintroduction of animal and plant species in these natural areas, thereby making a contribution to a sustainable and lasting development of the region.

lsp.query: Zweitens fehlt es in den meisten Fällen an Möglichkeiten, die Anreize auch wirklich zu nutzen. So kann sich ein Junglandwirt aufgrund der Quoten nicht wirklich betätigen, da die Quoten für alle Erzeugnisse ausgeschöpft sind und er entweder warten muss, bis eine nationale Reserve gebildet und auf die Junglandwirte aufgeteilt wird, oder aber Quoten aufkaufen muss, was ihn aber nie auf einen grünen Zweig bringen dürfte.
lsp.judge: Secondly, in most cases, there is a lack of opportunities to actually take advantage of the incentives. Thus, a young farmer cannot really get started due to the quotas, as the quotas for all products are exhausted and he either has to wait until a national reserve is formed and distributed to the young farmers, or he has to buy quotas, which should never bring him a profit.
lsp.proxy: Secondly, there are usually insufficient opportunities to actually make use of the incentives. lsp.query: Vergegenwärtigen wir uns doch bloß einmal - und dabei beziehe ich mich auf mein Land -, wie in der Milchwirtschaft nun wirklich alles, vom Grashalm bis zur Milchablieferung im Supermarkt, kontrolliert wird, wie ferner Landwirte und Gärtner schon seit langem eine lückenlose Umwelt- und Kundenbuchhaltung führen müssen - was sie ja auch überaus engagiert tun -, und wie gleichzeitig die Tierschutzbestimmungen in den Ländern der Europäischen Union zu den weltweit strengsten gehören.
lsp.judge: Let's just take a moment to consider - and I'm referring to my country here - how everything in the dairy industry, from the blade of grass to the milk delivery in the supermarket, is actually controlled, how farmers and gardeners have been required to maintain comprehensive environmental and customer accounting for a long time - which they also do with great dedication -, and how at the same time, the animal welfare regulations in the countries of the European Union are among the strictest in the world.

lsp.query: Abschließend und im Rahmen dieser Hilfen für die erneuerbaren Energien, die für mich wesentlich sind und nicht nur für Erklärungen herhalten, sondern eine Zielsetzung darstellen - und denken Sie daran, dass zum ersten Mal Staat für Staat konkrete und differenzierte Ziele aufgestellt werden und zwar in der Richtlinie über grüne Energie -, halte ich es auf jeden Fall für unerlässlich, der Forschung im Nuklearsektor weiterhin Unterstützung zu geben, insbesondere im Bereich der Sicherheit, Lagerung und Aufbereitung von Rückständen, denn sie u vergraben ist keine Lösung, oder bei Alternativfragen wie beispielsweise der Kernfusion.
lsp.judge: In conclusion, and within the framework of these measures to support renewable energy, which are essential to me and not just for explanations, but represent a goal - and remember that for the first time, country by country, concrete and differentiated goals are being set, namely in the directive on green energy - I consider it essential to continue providing support to research in the nuclear sector, particularly in the areas of safety, storage, and processing of residues, because burying them is not a solution, or in alternative questions such as nuclear fusion.

lsp.query: Unser Potenzial an erneuerbaren Energien in der Europäischen Union ist begrenzt, sowohl aus physikalischen Gründen - denn mit Ausnahme der Sonnenenergie, bei der wir vielleicht einen größeren Spielraum haben, sind den anderen klare Grenzen gesetzt - wie auch aus wirtschaftlichen Gründen, denn in der Tat benötigen die erneuerbaren Energien Hilfen - und ich sagte schon, dass ich konkrete und positive Maßnahmen in dieser Richtung ergriffen habe -, aber dennoch müssen ein gewisses Niveau der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und eine bestimmte Ausgewogenheit gewahrt bleiben.
lsp.judge: Our potential for renewable energy in the European Union is limited, both for physical reasons - because, apart from solar energy, where we may have more leeway, the others have clear limits - and for economic reasons, because in fact renewable energies need help - and I said that I have taken concrete and positive measures in this direction -, but still a certain level of competitiveness and a certain balance must be maintained.
